fact: NCRA told the ID4Africa AGM on 22 May 2025 that over 80% of CRVS/ID services are digitised and are delivered through regional and district offices, centres in populated areas, mobile/roving registration centres and Ministry of Health facilities, while Permanent Registration Centres at chiefdom and ward levels are still to be established; it gives no count of offices doing digital entry.
title: Civil Registration in Sierra Leone: Progress and Policy Reforms
